title: Mirza Ghasemi
description: A traditional dish from Iran, centered on eggplant, garlic, tomato, chicken egg. A measured home-kitchen version organized by cooking step.

steps.instruction: Cut the vegetables evenly and roast at 200°C for about 35 minutes until tender and lightly charred.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 9 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Add the listed ingredients to the pot. Keep at a gentle simmer for about 10 minutes, until tender and cooked through.
